name: webiny-mailer-providers
description: Use when sending Webiny's email through Resend, SendGrid or Amazon SES instead of SMTP, when choosing a mail provider, or when writing a custom mail transport. Triggers on: "use Resend", "use SendGrid", "use SES", "Amazon SES", "replace SMTP", "mail provider", "custom transport", "ResendMailer", "SendGridMailer", "SesMailer", "MailTransportFactory".
